description: Prompt-injection detector for text an agent is about to feed to a model: tool results, scraped pages or user input. Rules and heuristics only, no LLM, fast and deterministic. Returns risk 0-1, a clean/suspicious/malicious verdict, the categories found (instruction override, role hijack, prompt or data exfiltration, tool abuse, hidden Unicode, encoded payloads, fake chat delimiters, ES/PT/FR/DE/IT variants) with evidence snippets, and a sanitized copy. POST with JSON {text, context} also works. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

context.description: Where the text comes from: tool_output, user_input (default) or web_page

text.description: Text to inspect, up to 200 KB
